subject: On-prem IaC ownership & evidence request
messages:
From: Taylor Brooks <ops@acme-financial.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: on-prem Terraform/Helm/Ansible

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

We're kicking off our scheduled controls audit for the private deployment of Redwood in our VPC/on-prem environment. The audit team needs a concise ownership matrix and artifact pointers for the following areas:

- Terraform modules that provision VPCs, subnets, and network ACLs
- Helm charts responsible for control-plane components and ingress
- Ansible playbooks for bare-metal bootstrap and bastion configuration
- CI/CD pipelines that build, push, and deploy artifacts (including artifact retention and signing)
- Evidence of automated tests or gating that prevent insecure changes reaching prod-like clusters

Can you provide: (1) a short ownership table (who owns which module), (2) links to the canonical repos and pipeline runs, and (3) any retained artifacts or CVs for signing keys? We'd like this by EOD Thursday so the auditors can start their sampling.

Attachments: none on our side — audit will accept zipped artifacts or Drive links.

Thanks,
Taylor Brooks
Ops / Acme Financial
ops@acme-financial.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Brooks <ops@acme-financial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: on-prem Terraform/Helm/Ansible

Thanks Taylor — we'll assemble this. I'm looping in Jordan (module steward for infra) and Marissa (CI/ops). Jordan/Marissa: can you confirm owners and where the canonical artifacts live? I've started a checklist (attached) so we can hand over a single bundle.

Immediate asks for internal owners:
- Terraform network modules (VPC/subnet/egress): owner + repo URL
- Helm charts for control plane / ingress: owner + chart repo URL
- Ansible playbooks and inventories for on-prem bootstrap: owner + playbook repo URL
- CI/CD pipelines (build/deploy): link to pipeline definitions and most recent successful run IDs
- Artifact retention policy and signing key metadata (where the keys are stored, rotation schedule)

I've attached: iac-evidence-checklist-v1.pdf — use this to populate responses. If we can't get everything by Thu EOD, call a 30m sync for Wed AM.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Platform Security (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: iac-evidence-checklist-v1.pdf

Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: on-prem Terraform/Helm/Ansible

I'm attaching a short CSV with artifact retention summaries that Marissa maintains. I'll follow up with signed-key metadata offline (HSM notes).

Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Taylor Brooks <ops@acme-financial.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: on-prem Terraform/Helm/Ansible

Adding CI details and a couple of notes for auditors:

- Artifact retention: we keep build artifacts in registry.redwood.ai for 90 days by default; promoted release artifacts are copied to the long-term bucket (s3://artifacts-priv-release) and retained for 3 years. See attached CSV for snapshot (ci-artifact-retention.csv).
- Signing: release artifacts are signed by an offline key whose public cert is in the repo (keys/RELEASE.pub). Private key is in the HSM (AWS CloudHSM) and rotation schedule is quarterly — rotation tickets are under SUP-456.
- CI gating: merge requests require: linters, unit tests, terraform plan safety checks, and a staged deploy to canary namespace. Gating is enforced by GitLab pipeline rules and OPA policies in the repo.

One operational caveat: the Ansible inventory for some older rack hosts still references legacy IPs. We'll note that in the evidence bundle and flag it for remediation; it does not affect current clusters.

Kimberly/Taylor: I can assemble the zipped evidence bundle (ownership matrix + pipeline run exports + signing metadata) and place it in the Drive folder linked below. Propose 4pm PT tomorrow for a short handoff review.

Marissa Cole
Sr. DevOps Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: ci-artifact-retention.csv

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
